```yaml
# Actuator y Observabilidad
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,info,metrics,prometheus,circuitbreakers,circuitbreakerevents,httptrace
      base-path: /actuator
  endpoint:
    health:
      show-details: when-authorized
      probes:
        enabled: true
    metrics:
      enabled: true
    prometheus:
      enabled: true
  metrics:
    export:
      prometheus:
        enabled: true
        step: 30s
        descriptions: true
    distribution:
      percentiles-histogram:
        "[http.server.requests]": true
        "[resilience4j.circuitbreaker.calls]": true
      percentiles:
        "[http.server.requests]": 0.5, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99
        "[resilience4j.circuitbreaker.calls]": 0.5, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99
      slo:
        "[http.server.requests]": 100ms, 500ms, 1s
    tags:
      application: ${spring.application.name}
      environment: ${spring.profiles.active:default}
      version: @project.version@
  tracing:
    sampling:
      probability: 1.0
  health:
    circuitbreakers:
      enabled: true
    livenessstate:
      enabled: true
    readinessstate:
      enabled: true

# OpenAPI/Swagger
springdoc:
  api-docs:
    path: /api-docs
  swagger-ui:
    path: /swagger-ui.html
    enabled: true

# Services Configuration
services:
  fria:
    base-url: ${FRIA_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8098}
  immutable-logs:
    base-url: ${IMMUTABLE_LOGS_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8095}
  hitl:
    base-url: ${HITL_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8099}
  qms:
    base-url: ${QMS_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8098}
  technical-docs:
    base-url: ${TECHNICAL_DOCS_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8100}
  prohibited-systems:
    base-url: ${PROHIBITED_SYSTEMS_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8080}
    # Nota: Actualmente ProhibitedSystem está en el mismo proyecto (BusinessService),
    # pero se configura aquí por si en el futuro se mueve a un microservicio separado
  pmm:
    base-url: ${PMM_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8095}
  eu-registration:
    base-url: ${EU_REGISTRATION_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8099}

# Logging
logging:
  level:
    com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance: INFO
    org.springframework.web: DEBUG
    io.github.resilience4j: DEBUG
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.config;

import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreakerRegistry;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.Retry;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.RetryRegistry;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

/**
 * Configuración de resiliencia (Circuit Breakers y Retry).
 *
 * Los circuit breakers y retries se configuran en application.yml
 * y se registran aquí para inyección en los servicios.
 */
@Configuration
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ResilienceConfig {

    private final CircuitBreakerRegistry circuitBreakerRegistry;
    private final RetryRegistry retryRegistry;

    @Bean("projectServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker projectServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("projectService");
    }

        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("bpmnService");
    }

    public CircuitBreaker classificationBusinessServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("classificationBusinessService");
    }

    @Bean("projectServiceRetry")
    public Retry projectServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("projectService");
    }

    @Bean("bpmnServiceRetry")
    public Retry bpmnServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("bpmnService");
    }

    @Bean("catalogServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker catalogServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("catalogService");
    }

    @Bean("friaServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker friaServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("friaService");
    }

    @Bean("friaServiceRetry")
    public Retry friaServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("friaService");
    }

    @Bean("immutableLogsServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker immutableLogsServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("immutableLogsService");
    }

    @Bean("immutableLogsServiceRetry")
    public Retry immutableLogsServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("immutableLogsService");
    }

    @Bean("hitlServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker hitlServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("hitlService");
    }

    @Bean("hitlServiceRetry")
    public Retry hitlServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("hitlService");
    }

    @Bean("euRegistrationServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker euRegistrationServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("euRegistrationService");
    }

    @Bean("euRegistrationServiceRetry")
    public Retry euRegistrationServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("euRegistrationService");
    }

    @Bean("technicalDocsServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker technicalDocsServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("technicalDocsService");
    }

    @Bean("technicalDocsServiceRetry")

    }

    @Bean("pmmServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker pmmServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("pmmService");
    }

    @Bean("pmmServiceRetry")
    public Retry pmmServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("pmmService");
    }

    @Bean("qmsServiceCircuitBreaker")
    public CircuitBreaker qmsServiceCircuitBreaker() {
        return circuitBreakerRegistry.circuitBreaker("qmsService");
    }

    @Bean("qmsServiceRetry")
    public Retry qmsServiceRetry() {
        return retryRegistry.retry("qmsService");
    }

    @Bean("traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker")
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service.impl;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service.TraceabilityService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.retry.RetryOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.Retry;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Implementación reactiva del servicio Traceability con resiliencia.
 *
 * Este servicio:
 * 1. Llama al microservicio de Traceability con circuit breakers y retry
 * 2. Maneja errores y timeouts
 * 3. Proporciona métricas y observabilidad
 */
@Slf4j
@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class TraceabilityServiceImpl implements TraceabilityService {

    private final WebClient webClient;
    private final CircuitBreaker traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker;
    private final Retry traceabilityServiceRetry;

    @Value("${services.traceability.base-url:http://localhost:8098}")
    private String traceabilityServiceBaseUrl;

    public TraceabilityServiceImpl(
            WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder,
            @Qualifier("traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker") CircuitBreaker traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker,
            @Qualifier("traceabilityServiceRetry") Retry traceabilityServiceRetry) {
        this.webClient = webClientBuilder.build();
        this.traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker = traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker;
        this.traceabilityServiceRetry = traceabilityServiceRetry;
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<TraceabilityEvidenceDto> getTraceability(String entityType, Long entityId) {
        log.info("Getting traceability: entityType={}, entityId={}", entityType, entityId);

        String uri = traceabilityServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/traceability";
        if (entityType != null && entityId != null) {
            uri += "?entityType=" + entityType + "&entityId=" + entityId;
        }

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(uri)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(traceabilityServiceRetry))
                .doOnNext(response -> log.debug("Retrieved traceability for {}: {}", entityType, entityId))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting traceability", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<TraceabilityEvidenceDto> getEntityTraceability(String entityType, Long entityId) {
        log.info("Getting entity traceability: entityType={}, entityId={}", entityType, entityId);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(traceabilityServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/traceability/{entityType}/{id}", entityType, entityId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(traceabilityServiceRetry))
                .doOnNext(response -> log.debug("Retrieved entity traceability for {}: {}", entityType, entityId))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting entity traceability", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<TraceabilityEvidenceDto> searchTraceability(TraceabilitySearchCriteriaDto criteria) {
        log.info("Searching traceability with criteria: entityType={}, entityId={}",
                criteria.getEntityType(), criteria.getEntityId());

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(traceabilityServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/traceability/search")
                .bodyValue(criteria)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(traceabilityServiceRetry))
                .doOnNext(response -> log.debug("Found traceability data"))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error searching traceability", error));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<TraceabilityEvidenceDto> exportEvidence(String entityType, Long entityId, String format) {
        log.info("Exporting evidence: entityType={}, entityId={}, format={}", entityType, entityId, format);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(uriBuilder -> uriBuilder
                        .path(traceabilityServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/traceability/export")
                        .queryParam("entityType", entityType)
                        .queryParam("entityId", entityId)
                        .queryParam("format", format)
                        .build())
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(traceabilityServiceRetry))
                .doOnNext(response -> log.info("Exported evidence for {}: {} as {}", entityType, entityId, format))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error exporting evidence", error));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.metrics.ComplianceMetrics;
import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service.TraceabilityService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import io.micrometer.core.annotation.Timed;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Controller reactivo para Traceability.
 *
 * Este controller actúa como BFF, proporcionando endpoints optimizados
 * para el frontend que llaman al microservicio de Traceability.
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/traceability - Obtener trazabilidad general o específica
 * - GET /api/v1/traceability/{entityType}/{id} - Obtener trazabilidad de entidad específica
 * - POST /api/v1/traceability/search - Buscar trazabilidad con criterios
 * - POST /api/v1/traceability/export - Exportar evidencias de trazabilidad
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/traceability")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "Traceability", description = "Trazabilidad y evidencias según Art. 12 y 19 EU AI Act")
@Timed(value = "compliance.traceability.controller", description = "Métricas del controller Traceability")
public class TraceabilityController {

    private final TraceabilityService traceabilityService;
    private final ComplianceMetrics metrics;

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener trazabilidad general o específica",
            description = "Retorna trazabilidad general o específica si se proporcionan entityType y entityId"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Trazabilidad obtenida exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Parámetros inválidos"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.traceability.get", description = "Tiempo de obtención de trazabilidad")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>> getTraceability(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String entityType,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Long entityId) {

        log.info("Getting traceability: entityType={}, entityId={}", entityType, entityId);

        Timer.Sample timer = metrics.startClassificationTimer();

        return traceabilityService.getTraceability(entityType, entityId)
                .map(response -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.get.duration",
                            "status", "success"));
                    log.info("Retrieved traceability for {}: {}", entityType, entityId);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.get.duration",
                            "status", "error"));
                    metrics.recordClassificationError("traceability.get", error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    log.error("Error getting traceability", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{entityType}/{id}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener trazabilidad de entidad específica",
            description = "Retorna trazabilidad completa de una entidad (Model, Project, Agent) con logs, decisiones HITL y outputs"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Trazabilidad obtenida exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Tipo de entidad inválido"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Entidad no encontrada"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.traceability.get-entity", description = "Tiempo de obtención de trazabilidad de entidad")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>> getEntityTraceability(
            @PathVariable String entityType,
            @PathVariable Long id) {

        log.info("Getting entity traceability: entityType={}, id={}", entityType, id);

        Timer.Sample timer = metrics.startClassificationTimer();

        return traceabilityService.getEntityTraceability(entityType, id)
                .map(response -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.get-entity.duration",
                            "status", "success"));
                    log.info("Retrieved entity traceability for {}: {}", entityType, id);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.get-entity.duration",
                            "status", "error"));
                    metrics.recordClassificationError("traceability.get-entity", error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    log.error("Error getting entity traceability", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/search")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Buscar trazabilidad con criterios",
            description = "Busca trazabilidad aplicando filtros de tipo de entidad, fecha, usuario, etc."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Búsqueda completada exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Criterios inválidos"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.traceability.search", description = "Tiempo de búsqueda de trazabilidad")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>> searchTraceability(
            @Valid @RequestBody TraceabilitySearchCriteriaDto criteria) {

        log.info("Searching traceability with criteria: entityType={}, entityId={}",
                criteria.getEntityType(), criteria.getEntityId());

        Timer.Sample timer = metrics.startClassificationTimer();

        return traceabilityService.searchTraceability(criteria)
                .map(response -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.search.duration",
                            "status", "success"));
                    log.info("Search completed successfully");
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.search.duration",
                            "status", "error"));
                    metrics.recordClassificationError("traceability.search", error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    log.error("Error searching traceability", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/export")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Exportar evidencias de trazabilidad",
            description = "Exporta evidencias de trazabilidad en formato JSON o PDF con verificación de integridad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evidencias exportadas exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = TraceabilityEvidenceDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Parámetros inválidos"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    @Timed(value = "compliance.traceability.export", description = "Tiempo de exportación de evidencias")
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>> exportEvidence(
            @RequestParam String entityType,
            @RequestParam Long entityId,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "JSON") String format) {

        log.info("Exporting evidence: entityType={}, entityId={}, format={}", entityType, entityId, format);

        Timer.Sample timer = metrics.startClassificationTimer();

        return traceabilityService.exportEvidence(entityType, entityId, format)
                .map(response -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.export.duration",
                            "status", "success"));
                    log.info("Evidence exported successfully for {}: {} as {}", entityType, entityId, format);
                    return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    timer.stop(metrics.meterRegistry.timer("compliance.traceability.export.duration",
                            "status", "error"));
                    metrics.recordClassificationError("traceability.export", error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                    log.error("Error exporting evidence", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<TraceabilityEvidenceDto>status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }
}
```

Integración del BFF completada. Resumen:

## Integración BFF completada

### 1. Configuración en `application.yml`
- Agregado `services.traceability.base-url` con puerto 8098
- Agregado circuit breaker `traceabilityService` en Resilience4j
- Agregado retry `traceabilityService` con 3 intentos

### 2. Beans de resiliencia
- Agregado `traceabilityServiceCircuitBreaker` en `ResilienceConfig`
- Agregado `traceabilityServiceRetry` en `ResilienceConfig`

### 3. Servicio TraceabilityService
- Interfaz: `TraceabilityService.java`
- Implementación: `TraceabilityServiceImpl.java` con:
  - WebClient reactivo
  - Circuit breakers y retry
  - Manejo de errores
  - Logging

### 4. Controller TraceabilityController
- Endpoints:
  - `GET /api/v1/traceability` - Trazabilidad general o específica
  - `GET /api/v1/traceability/{entityType}/{id}` - Trazabilidad de entidad
  - `POST /api/v1/traceability/search` - Búsqueda con criterios
  - `POST /api/v1/traceability/export` - Exportar evidencias
- Métricas: integrado con `ComplianceMetrics`
- Documentación: Swagger/OpenAPI

### 5. Flujo completo
```
Frontend (Next.js)
    ↓ HTTP
BFF (codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance) [Reactivo - WebFlux]
    ↓ WebClient (Reactivo) con Circuit Breaker y Retry
Microservicio Traceability (codeflowx-governance-traceability-service) [Reactivo - WebFlux]
    ↓ Mono.fromCallable() (envuelve llamadas síncronas)
TraceabilityService (codeflowx.govern.business) [Síncrono - JPA]
    ↓
ImmutableLoggingBusinessService + DAO
    ↓
Entidades JPA
```

### Configuración de URL
La URL del microservicio se configura mediante variable de entorno:
```yaml
services:
  traceability:
    base-url: ${TRACEABILITY_SERVICE_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8098}
```

### Estado
- BFF configurado con circuit breakers y retry
- Servicio y controller implementados
- Integración con métricas y observabilidad
- Listo para desplegar

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.repository.models;

import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.models.Model;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.GenericRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * Repositorio para Model
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.logging.ImmutableLoggingBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.client.BpmnWorkflowClient;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.logging.ImmutableLog;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.models.Model;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.agents.Agent;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.HitlDecision;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.models.ModelRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.agents.AgentRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.logging.ImmutableLogRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.HitlDecisionRepository;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * BusinessService para Trazabilidad según Art. 12 y 19 EU AI Act
 *
 * Proporciona trazabilidad completa modelo-dataset-output con logs inmutables,
 * decisiones HITL y outputs generados.
 *
 * Ubicación: codeflowx.govern.business/src/main/java/com/codeflowx/govern/business/compliance/
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class TraceabilityService {

    @Autowired
    private DAO dao;

    @Autowired
    private ImmutableLoggingBusinessService immutableLoggingBusinessService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private ProcessRuntimeService processRuntimeService;

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un modelo
     *
     * @param modelId ID del modelo
     * @return ModelTraceability con logs, dataset, versiones, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ModelTraceability getModelTraceability(Long modelId) {
        log.info("Retrieving model traceability for modelId: {}", modelId);

        // Obtener modelo
        Model model = dao.findById(Model.class, modelId);
        if (model == null) {
            log.warn("Model not found: {}", modelId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Model not found: " + modelId);
        }

        // Obtener logs inmutables del modelo
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLoggingBusinessService.getEntityLogsWithVerification("Model", modelId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas
        String decisionQuery = "SELECT * FROM HITLDECISIONS WHERE HITLENTITYTYPE = ? AND HITLENTITYID = ? ORDER BY HITLDECISIONTIMESTAMP DESC";
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Model", modelId);

        // Obtener outputs generados (si existe tabla de outputs)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía - se puede implementar cuando exista la entidad
        List<ModelTraceability.ModelOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ModelTraceability traceability = new ModelTraceability();
        traceability.setModel(model);
        traceability.setTrainingDatasetId(model.getModtrainingdatasetid());
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for model {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            modelId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un proyecto
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @return ProjectTraceability con modelos, logs, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ProjectTraceability getProjectTraceability(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving project traceability for projectId: {}", projectId);

        // Obtener proyecto
        Project project = dao.findById(Project.class, projectId);
        if (project == null) {
            log.warn("Project not found: {}", projectId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId);
        }

        // Obtener modelos del proyecto
        String modelQuery = "SELECT * FROM MODMODELS WHERE MODPROJECTID = ?";
        List<Model> models = dao.findListBySQL(Model.class, modelQuery, projectId);

        // Obtener logs inmutables del proyecto
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLoggingBusinessService.getEntityLogsWithVerification("Project", projectId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas
        String decisionQuery = "SELECT * FROM HITLDECISIONS WHERE HITLENTITYTYPE = ? AND HITLENTITYID = ? ORDER BY HITLDECISIONTIMESTAMP DESC";
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Project", projectId);

        // Obtener outputs (lista vacía por ahora)
        List<ProjectTraceability.ProjectOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ProjectTraceability traceability = new ProjectTraceability();
        traceability.setProject(project);
        traceability.setModels(models);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for project {}: {} models, {} logs, {} decisions",
            projectId, models.size(), logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un agente
     *
     * @param agentId ID del agente
     * @return AgentTraceability con ejecuciones, prompts, outputs y decisiones
     */
    public AgentTraceability getAgentTraceability(Long agentId) {
        log.info("Retrieving agent traceability for agentId: {}", agentId);

        // Obtener agente
        Agent agent = dao.findById(Agent.class, agentId);
        if (agent == null) {
            log.warn("Agent not found: {}", agentId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agent not found: " + agentId);
        }

        // Obtener logs inmutables del agente
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLoggingBusinessService.getEntityLogsWithVerification("Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas
        String decisionQuery = "SELECT * FROM HITLDECISIONS WHERE HITLENTITYTYPE = ? AND HITLENTITYID = ? ORDER BY HITLDECISIONTIMESTAMP DESC";
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener ejecuciones del agente (si existe tabla)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentExecution> executions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        AgentTraceability traceability = new AgentTraceability();
        traceability.setAgent(agent);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setExecutions(executions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for agent {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            agentId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Exporta evidencias de trazabilidad para una entidad
     *
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Model, Project, Agent)
     * @return TraceabilityEvidence con toda la trazabilidad y verificación de integridad
     */
    public TraceabilityEvidence exportTraceabilityEvidence(Long entityId, String entityType) {
        log.info("Exporting traceability evidence for {}: {}", entityType, entityId);

        TraceabilityEvidence evidence = new TraceabilityEvidence();
        evidence.setEntityType(entityType);
        evidence.setEntityId(entityId);

        // Obtener trazabilidad según tipo
        switch (entityType.toUpperCase()) {
            case "MODEL":
                evidence.setData(getModelTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "PROJECT":
                evidence.setData(getProjectTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "AGENT":
                evidence.setData(getAgentTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid entity type: " + entityType);
        }

        // Verificar integridad de logs
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = evidence.getData().getLogs();
        if (logs != null && logs.size() > 1) {
            Long firstId = logs.get(0).getIdximmutablelog();
            Long lastId = logs.get(logs.size() - 1).getIdximmutablelog();
            ImmutableLoggingBusinessService.LogIntegrityReport integrityReport =
                immutableLoggingBusinessService.verifyIntegrity(firstId, lastId);

            evidence.setIntegrityScore(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? 1.0 : 0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? "INTEGRITY_OK" : "INTEGRITY_ERROR");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(integrityReport.getTotalLogsChecked());
            evidence.setTotalLogs(logs.size());
        } else if (logs != null && logs.size() == 1) {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(1.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("INTEGRITY_OK");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(1);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(1);
        } else {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("NO_LOGS");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(0);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(0);
        }

        evidence.setExportDate(new java.sql.Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        log.info("Exported traceability evidence for {} {}: integrity score {}",
            entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityScore());

        // Si hay problemas de integridad, lanzar workflow BPMN de alerta
        if (evidence.getIntegrityStatus() != null &&
            (evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_ERROR") ||
             evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_WARNING"))) {
            triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityStatus());
        }

        return evidence;
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     *
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param integrityStatus Estado de integridad
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    public String triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(String entityType, Long entityId, String integrityStatus) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad: entityType={}, entityId={}, status={}",
                entityType, entityId, integrityStatus);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("entityType", entityType);
            variables.put("entityId", entityId);
            variables.put("integrityStatus", integrityStatus);
            variables.put("alertDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "traceability-integrity-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad disparado exitosamente: entityType={}, entityId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    entityType, entityId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad para {}: {}", entityType, entityId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la exportación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para trazabilidad de modelo
     */
    public static class ModelTraceability {
        private Model model;
        private Long trainingDatasetId;
        private List<ImmutableLog> logs;
        private List<HitlDecision> decisions;
        private List<ModelOutput> outputs;

        public static class ModelOutput {
            private Long id;
            private String timestamp;
            private String input;
            private String output;
            private Double confidence;

            // Getters y setters
            public Long getId() { return id; }
            public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
            public String getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
            public void setTimestamp(String timestamp) { this.timestamp = timestamp; }
            public String getInput() { return input; }
            public void setInput(String input) { this.input = input; }
            public String getOutput() { return output; }
            public void setOutput(String output) { this.output = output; }
            public Double getConfidence() { return confidence; }
            public void setConfidence(Double confidence) { this.confidence = confidence; }
        }

        // Getters y setters
        public Model getModel() { return model; }
        public void setModel(Model model) { this.model = model; }
        public Long getTrainingDatasetId() { return trainingDatasetId; }
        public void setTrainingDatasetId(Long trainingDatasetId) { this.trainingDatasetId = trainingDatasetId; }
        public List<ImmutableLog> getLogs() { return logs; }
        public void setLogs(List<ImmutableLog> logs) { this.logs = logs; }
        public List<HitlDecision> getDecisions() { return decisions; }
        public void setDecisions(List<HitlDecision> decisions) { this.decisions = decisions; }

    }

    /**

     */
    public static class AgentTraceability {

    /**

     */
    public static class TraceabilityEvidence {
        private String entityType;
        private Long entityId;
        private Object data; // ModelTraceability, ProjectTraceability o AgentTraceability
        private Double integrityScore;
        private String integrityStatus;
        private Integer verifiedLogs;
        private Integer totalLogs;
        private java.sql.Timestamp exportDate;

        // Getters y setters
        public String getEntityType() { return entityType; }
        public void setEntityType(String entityType) { this.entityType = entityType; }
        public Long getEntityId() { return entityId; }
        public void setEntityId(Long entityId) { this.entityId = entityId; }
        public Object getData() { return data; }
        public void setData(Object data) { this.data = data; }
        public Double getIntegrityScore() { return integrityScore; }
        public void setIntegrityScore(Double integrityScore) { this.integrityScore = integrityScore; }
        public String getIntegrityStatus() { return integrityStatus; }
        public void setIntegrityStatus(String integrityStatus) { this.integrityStatus = integrityStatus; }
        public Integer getVerifiedLogs() { return verifiedLogs; }
        public void setVerifiedLogs(Integer verifiedLogs) { this.verifiedLogs = verifiedLogs; }
        public Integer getTotalLogs() { return totalLogs; }
        public void setTotalLogs(Integer totalLogs) { this.totalLogs = totalLogs; }
        public java.sql.Timestamp getExportDate() { return exportDate; }
        public void setExportDate(java.sql.Timestamp exportDate) { this.exportDate = exportDate; }

        // Helper para obtener logs
        public List<ImmutableLog> getLogs() {
            if (data instanceof ModelTraceability) {
                return ((ModelTraceability) data).getLogs();
            } else if (data instanceof ProjectTraceability) {
                return ((ProjectTraceability) data).getLogs();
            } else if (data instanceof AgentTraceability) {
                return ((AgentTraceability) data).getLogs();
            }
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for project {}: {} models, {} logs, {} decisions",
            projectId, models.size(), logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un agente
     *
     * @param agentId ID del agente
     * @return AgentTraceability con ejecuciones, prompts, outputs y decisiones
     */
    public AgentTraceability getAgentTraceability(Long agentId) {
        log.info("Retrieving agent traceability for agentId: {}", agentId);

        // Obtener agente
        Agent agent = dao.findById(Agent.class, agentId);
        if (agent == null) {
            log.warn("Agent not found: {}", agentId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agent not found: " + agentId);
        }

        // Obtener logs inmutables del agente
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLoggingBusinessService.getEntityLogsWithVerification("Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas
        String decisionQuery = "SELECT * FROM HITLDECISIONS WHERE HITLENTITYTYPE = ? AND HITLENTITYID = ? ORDER BY HITLDECISIONTIMESTAMP DESC";
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener ejecuciones del agente (si existe tabla)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentExecution> executions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        AgentTraceability traceability = new AgentTraceability();
        traceability.setAgent(agent);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setExecutions(executions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for agent {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            agentId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Exporta evidencias de trazabilidad para una entidad
     *
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Model, Project, Agent)
     * @return TraceabilityEvidence con toda la trazabilidad y verificación de integridad
     */
    public TraceabilityEvidence exportTraceabilityEvidence(Long entityId, String entityType) {
        log.info("Exporting traceability evidence for {}: {}", entityType, entityId);

        TraceabilityEvidence evidence = new TraceabilityEvidence();
        evidence.setEntityType(entityType);
        evidence.setEntityId(entityId);

        // Obtener trazabilidad según tipo
        switch (entityType.toUpperCase()) {
            case "MODEL":
                evidence.setData(getModelTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "PROJECT":
                evidence.setData(getProjectTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "AGENT":
                evidence.setData(getAgentTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid entity type: " + entityType);
        }

        // Verificar integridad de logs
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = evidence.getData().getLogs();
        if (logs != null && logs.size() > 1) {
            Long firstId = logs.get(0).getIdximmutablelog();
            Long lastId = logs.get(logs.size() - 1).getIdximmutablelog();
            ImmutableLoggingBusinessService.LogIntegrityReport integrityReport =
                immutableLoggingBusinessService.verifyIntegrity(firstId, lastId);

            evidence.setIntegrityScore(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? 1.0 : 0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? "INTEGRITY_OK" : "INTEGRITY_ERROR");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(integrityReport.getTotalLogsChecked());
            evidence.setTotalLogs(logs.size());
        } else if (logs != null && logs.size() == 1) {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(1.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("INTEGRITY_OK");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(1);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(1);
        } else {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("NO_LOGS");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(0);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(0);
        }

        evidence.setExportDate(new java.sql.Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        log.info("Exported traceability evidence for {} {}: integrity score {}",
            entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityScore());

        // Si hay problemas de integridad, lanzar workflow BPMN de alerta
        if (evidence.getIntegrityStatus() != null &&
            (evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_ERROR") ||
             evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_WARNING"))) {
            triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityStatus());
        }

        return evidence;
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     *
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param integrityStatus Estado de integridad
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    public String triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(String entityType, Long entityId, String integrityStatus) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad: entityType={}, entityId={}, status={}",
                entityType, entityId, integrityStatus);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("entityType", entityType);
            variables.put("entityId", entityId);
            variables.put("integrityStatus", integrityStatus);
            variables.put("alertDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "traceability-integrity-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad disparado exitosamente: entityType={}, entityId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    entityType, entityId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad para {}: {}", entityType, entityId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la exportación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

            if (data instanceof ModelTraceability) {

            } else if (data instanceof ProjectTraceability) {
                return ((ProjectTraceability) data).getLogs();

            return new ArrayList<>();
```

```java
    public ModelTraceability getModelTraceability(Long modelId) {
        log.info("Retrieving model traceability for modelId: {}", modelId);

        // Obtener modelo usando repositorio
        Optional<Model> modelOpt = modelRepository.findById(modelId);
        if (modelOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Model not found: {}", modelId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Model not found: " + modelId);
        }
        Model model = modelOpt.get();

        // Obtener logs inmutables del modelo usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Model", modelId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Model").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(modelId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener outputs generados (si existe tabla de outputs)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía - se puede implementar cuando exista la entidad
        List<ModelTraceability.ModelOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ModelTraceability traceability = new ModelTraceability();
        traceability.setModel(model);
        traceability.setTrainingDatasetId(model.getModtrainingdatasetid());
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for model {}: {} logs, {} decisions",

        return traceability;

        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Project", projectId);
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.logging.ImmutableLoggingBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.client.BpmnWorkflowClient;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.logging.ImmutableLog;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.models.Model;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.agents.Agent;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.HitlDecision;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.models.ModelRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.agents.AgentRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.logging.ImmutableLogRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.HitlDecisionRepository;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * BusinessService para Trazabilidad según Art. 12 y 19 EU AI Act
 *
 * Proporciona trazabilidad completa modelo-dataset-output con logs inmutables,
 * decisiones HITL y outputs generados.
 *
 * Ubicación: codeflowx.govern.business/src/main/java/com/codeflowx/govern/business/compliance/
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class TraceabilityService {

    @Autowired
    private ModelRepository modelRepository;

    @Autowired
    private AgentRepository agentRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ImmutableLogRepository immutableLogRepository;

    @Autowired
    private HitlDecisionRepository hitlDecisionRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ImmutableLoggingBusinessService immutableLoggingBusinessService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private BpmnWorkflowClient bpmnWorkflowClient;

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un modelo
     *
     * @param modelId ID del modelo
     * @return ModelTraceability con logs, dataset, versiones, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ModelTraceability getModelTraceability(Long modelId) {
        log.info("Retrieving model traceability for modelId: {}", modelId);

        // Obtener modelo usando repositorio
        Optional<Model> modelOpt = modelRepository.findById(modelId);
        if (modelOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Model not found: {}", modelId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Model not found: " + modelId);
        }
        Model model = modelOpt.get();

        // Obtener logs inmutables del modelo usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Model", modelId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Model").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(modelId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener outputs generados (si existe tabla de outputs)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía - se puede implementar cuando exista la entidad
        List<ModelTraceability.ModelOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ModelTraceability traceability = new ModelTraceability();
        traceability.setModel(model);
        traceability.setTrainingDatasetId(model.getModtrainingdatasetid());
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for model {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            modelId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un proyecto
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @return ProjectTraceability con modelos, logs, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ProjectTraceability getProjectTraceability(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving project traceability for projectId: {}", projectId);

        // Obtener proyecto usando repositorio
        Optional<Project> projectOpt = projectRepository.findById(projectId);
        if (projectOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Project not found: {}", projectId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId);
        }
        Project project = projectOpt.get();

        // Obtener modelos del proyecto usando repositorio
        List<Model> models = modelRepository.findByProjectId(projectId);

        // Obtener logs inmutables del proyecto usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Project", projectId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Project").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(projectId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener outputs (lista vacía por ahora)
        List<ProjectTraceability.ProjectOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ProjectTraceability traceability = new ProjectTraceability();
        traceability.setProject(project);
        traceability.setModels(models);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for project {}: {} models, {} logs, {} decisions",
            projectId, models.size(), logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un agente
     *
     * @param agentId ID del agente
     * @return AgentTraceability con ejecuciones, prompts, outputs y decisiones
     */
    public AgentTraceability getAgentTraceability(Long agentId) {
        log.info("Retrieving agent traceability for agentId: {}", agentId);

        // Obtener agente
        Agent agent = dao.findById(Agent.class, agentId);
        if (agent == null) {
            log.warn("Agent not found: {}", agentId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agent not found: " + agentId);
        }

        // Obtener logs inmutables del agente
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLoggingBusinessService.getEntityLogsWithVerification("Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas
        String decisionQuery = "SELECT * FROM HITLDECISIONS WHERE HITLENTITYTYPE = ? AND HITLENTITYID = ? ORDER BY HITLDECISIONTIMESTAMP DESC";
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = dao.findListBySQL(HitlDecision.class, decisionQuery, "Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener ejecuciones del agente (si existe tabla)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentExecution> executions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        AgentTraceability traceability = new AgentTraceability();
        traceability.setAgent(agent);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setExecutions(executions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for agent {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            agentId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Exporta evidencias de trazabilidad para una entidad
     *
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Model, Project, Agent)
     * @return TraceabilityEvidence con toda la trazabilidad y verificación de integridad
     */
    public TraceabilityEvidence exportTraceabilityEvidence(Long entityId, String entityType) {
        log.info("Exporting traceability evidence for {}: {}", entityType, entityId);

        TraceabilityEvidence evidence = new TraceabilityEvidence();
        evidence.setEntityType(entityType);
        evidence.setEntityId(entityId);

        // Obtener trazabilidad según tipo
        switch (entityType.toUpperCase()) {
            case "MODEL":
                evidence.setData(getModelTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "PROJECT":
                evidence.setData(getProjectTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "AGENT":
                evidence.setData(getAgentTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid entity type: " + entityType);
        }

        // Verificar integridad de logs
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = evidence.getData().getLogs();
        if (logs != null && logs.size() > 1) {
            Long firstId = logs.get(0).getIdximmutablelog();
            Long lastId = logs.get(logs.size() - 1).getIdximmutablelog();
            ImmutableLoggingBusinessService.LogIntegrityReport integrityReport =
                immutableLoggingBusinessService.verifyIntegrity(firstId, lastId);

            evidence.setIntegrityScore(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? 1.0 : 0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? "INTEGRITY_OK" : "INTEGRITY_ERROR");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(integrityReport.getTotalLogsChecked());
            evidence.setTotalLogs(logs.size());
        } else if (logs != null && logs.size() == 1) {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(1.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("INTEGRITY_OK");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(1);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(1);
        } else {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("NO_LOGS");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(0);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(0);
        }

        evidence.setExportDate(new java.sql.Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        log.info("Exported traceability evidence for {} {}: integrity score {}",
            entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityScore());

        // Si hay problemas de integridad, lanzar workflow BPMN de alerta
        if (evidence.getIntegrityStatus() != null &&
            (evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_ERROR") ||
             evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_WARNING"))) {
            triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityStatus());
        }

        return evidence;
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     *
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param integrityStatus Estado de integridad
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    public String triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(String entityType, Long entityId, String integrityStatus) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad: entityType={}, entityId={}, status={}",
                entityType, entityId, integrityStatus);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("entityType", entityType);
            variables.put("entityId", entityId);
            variables.put("integrityStatus", integrityStatus);
            variables.put("alertDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "traceability-integrity-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad disparado exitosamente: entityType={}, entityId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    entityType, entityId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad para {}: {}", entityType, entityId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la exportación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }
```

```java
@Service
@Slf4j
public class TraceabilityService {

    @Autowired
    private ModelRepository modelRepository;

    @Autowired
    private AgentRepository agentRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ImmutableLogRepository immutableLogRepository;

    @Autowired
    private HitlDecisionRepository hitlDecisionRepository;

    @Autowired
    private ImmutableLoggingBusinessService immutableLoggingBusinessService;

    @Autowired(required = false)
    private BpmnWorkflowClient bpmnWorkflowClient;

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un modelo
     *
     * @param modelId ID del modelo
     * @return ModelTraceability con logs, dataset, versiones, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ModelTraceability getModelTraceability(Long modelId) {
        log.info("Retrieving model traceability for modelId: {}", modelId);

        // Obtener modelo usando repositorio
        Optional<Model> modelOpt = modelRepository.findById(modelId);
        if (modelOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Model not found: {}", modelId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Model not found: " + modelId);
        }
        Model model = modelOpt.get();

        // Obtener logs inmutables del modelo usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Model", modelId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Model").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(modelId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener outputs generados (si existe tabla de outputs)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía - se puede implementar cuando exista la entidad
        List<ModelTraceability.ModelOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ModelTraceability traceability = new ModelTraceability();
        traceability.setModel(model);
        traceability.setTrainingDatasetId(model.getModtrainingdatasetid());
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for model {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            modelId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un proyecto
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @return ProjectTraceability con modelos, logs, decisiones y outputs
     */
    public ProjectTraceability getProjectTraceability(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving project traceability for projectId: {}", projectId);

        // Obtener proyecto usando repositorio
        Optional<Project> projectOpt = projectRepository.findById(projectId);
        if (projectOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Project not found: {}", projectId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId);
        }
        Project project = projectOpt.get();

        // Obtener modelos del proyecto usando repositorio
        List<Model> models = modelRepository.findByProjectId(projectId);

        // Obtener logs inmutables del proyecto usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Project", projectId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Project").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(projectId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener outputs (lista vacía por ahora)
        List<ProjectTraceability.ProjectOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        ProjectTraceability traceability = new ProjectTraceability();
        traceability.setProject(project);
        traceability.setModels(models);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for project {}: {} models, {} logs, {} decisions",
            projectId, models.size(), logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene trazabilidad completa de un agente
     *
     * @param agentId ID del agente
     * @return AgentTraceability con ejecuciones, prompts, outputs y decisiones
     */
    public AgentTraceability getAgentTraceability(Long agentId) {
        log.info("Retrieving agent traceability for agentId: {}", agentId);

        // Obtener agente usando repositorio
        Optional<Agent> agentOpt = agentRepository.findById(agentId);
        if (agentOpt.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn("Agent not found: {}", agentId);
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Agent not found: " + agentId);
        }
        Agent agent = agentOpt.get();

        // Obtener logs inmutables del agente usando repositorio
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = immutableLogRepository.findByEntityTypeAndEntityId("Agent", agentId);

        // Obtener decisiones HITL relacionadas usando repositorio
        List<HitlDecision> decisions = hitlDecisionRepository.findByEntityType("Agent").stream()
                .filter(d -> d.getHitlentityid() != null && d.getHitlentityid().equals(agentId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        // Obtener ejecuciones del agente (si existe tabla)
        // Por ahora, retornamos lista vacía
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentExecution> executions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AgentTraceability.AgentOutput> outputs = new ArrayList<>();

        AgentTraceability traceability = new AgentTraceability();
        traceability.setAgent(agent);
        traceability.setLogs(logs);
        traceability.setDecisions(decisions);
        traceability.setExecutions(executions);
        traceability.setOutputs(outputs);

        log.info("Retrieved traceability for agent {}: {} logs, {} decisions",
            agentId, logs.size(), decisions.size());

        return traceability;
    }

    /**
     * Exporta evidencias de trazabilidad para una entidad
     *
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Model, Project, Agent)
     * @return TraceabilityEvidence con toda la trazabilidad y verificación de integridad
     */
    public TraceabilityEvidence exportTraceabilityEvidence(Long entityId, String entityType) {
        log.info("Exporting traceability evidence for {}: {}", entityType, entityId);

        TraceabilityEvidence evidence = new TraceabilityEvidence();
        evidence.setEntityType(entityType);
        evidence.setEntityId(entityId);

        // Obtener trazabilidad según tipo
        switch (entityType.toUpperCase()) {
            case "MODEL":
                evidence.setData(getModelTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "PROJECT":
                evidence.setData(getProjectTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            case "AGENT":
                evidence.setData(getAgentTraceability(entityId));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid entity type: " + entityType);
        }

        // Verificar integridad de logs
        List<ImmutableLog> logs = evidence.getData().getLogs();
        if (logs != null && logs.size() > 1) {
            Long firstId = logs.get(0).getIdximmutablelog();
            Long lastId = logs.get(logs.size() - 1).getIdximmutablelog();
            ImmutableLoggingBusinessService.LogIntegrityReport integrityReport =
                immutableLoggingBusinessService.verifyIntegrity(firstId, lastId);

            evidence.setIntegrityScore(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? 1.0 : 0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus(integrityReport.isIntegrityValid() ? "INTEGRITY_OK" : "INTEGRITY_ERROR");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(integrityReport.getTotalLogsChecked());
            evidence.setTotalLogs(logs.size());
        } else if (logs != null && logs.size() == 1) {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(1.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("INTEGRITY_OK");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(1);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(1);
        } else {
            evidence.setIntegrityScore(0.0);
            evidence.setIntegrityStatus("NO_LOGS");
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(0);
            evidence.setTotalLogs(0);
        }

        evidence.setExportDate(new java.sql.Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));

        log.info("Exported traceability evidence for {} {}: integrity score {}",
            entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityScore());

        // Si hay problemas de integridad, lanzar workflow BPMN de alerta
        if (evidence.getIntegrityStatus() != null &&
            (evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_ERROR") ||
             evidence.getIntegrityStatus().equals("INTEGRITY_WARNING"))) {
            triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(entityType, entityId, evidence.getIntegrityStatus());
        }

        return evidence;
    }

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el microservicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     *
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param integrityStatus Estado de integridad
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    public String triggerIntegrityAlertWorkflow(String entityType, Long entityId, String integrityStatus) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para alerta de integridad: entityType={}, entityId={}, status={}",
                entityType, entityId, integrityStatus);

        // Verificar si el servicio BPMN está disponible
        if (processRuntimeService == null) {
            log.warn("ProcessRuntimeService no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("entityType", entityType);
            variables.put("entityId", entityId);
            variables.put("integrityStatus", integrityStatus);
            variables.put("alertDate", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN
            ProcessInstance instance = processRuntimeService.startProcess(
                    "traceability-integrity-alert-workflow",
                    variables
            );

            String workflowInstanceId = instance.getProcessInstanceId();
            log.info("Workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad disparado exitosamente: entityType={}, entityId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    entityType, entityId, workflowInstanceId);

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN de alerta de integridad para {}: {}", entityType, entityId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la exportación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Clase interna para trazabilidad de modelo
     */
    public static class ModelTraceability {
        private Model model;
        private Long trainingDatasetId;
        private List<ImmutableLog> logs;
        private List<HitlDecision> decisions;
        private List<ModelOutput> outputs;

        public static class ModelOutput {
            private Long id;
            private String timestamp;
            private String input;
            private String output;
            private Double confidence;

            // Getters y setters
            public Long getId() { return id; }
            public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }
            public String getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
            public void setTimestamp(String timestamp) { this.timestamp = timestamp; }
            public String getInput() { return input; }
            public void setInput(String input) { this.input = input; }
            public String getOutput() { return output; }
            public void setOutput(String output) { this.output = output; }
            public Double getConfidence() { return confidence; }
            public void setConfidence(Double confidence) { this.confidence = confidence; }
        }

        // Getters y setters
        public Model getModel() { return model; }
        public void setModel(Model model) { this.model = model; }
        public Long getTrainingDatasetId() { return trainingDatasetId; }
        public void setTrainingDatasetId(Long trainingDatasetId) { this.trainingDatasetId = trainingDatasetId; }
        public List<ImmutableLog> getLogs() { return logs; }
        public void setLogs(List<ImmutableLog> logs) { this.logs = logs; }
        public List<HitlDecision> getDecisions() { return decisions; }
        public void setDecisions(List<HitlDecision> decisions) { this.decisions = decisions; }
        public List<Object> getOutputs() { return outputs; }
        public void setOutputs(List<Object> outputs) { this.outputs = outputs; }
    }

        private Object data; // ModelTraceability, ProjectTraceability o AgentTraceability
        private Double integrityScore;
        private String integrityStatus;
        private Integer verifiedLogs;
        private Integer totalLogs;
        private java.sql.Timestamp exportDate;

        // Getters y setters
        public String getEntityType() { return entityType; }
        public void setEntityType(String entityType) { this.entityType = entityType; }
        public Long getEntityId() { return entityId; }
        public void setEntityId(Long entityId) { this.entityId = entityId; }
        public Object getData() { return data; }
        public void setData(Object data) { this.data = data; }
        public Double getIntegrityScore() { return integrityScore; }
        public void setIntegrityScore(Double integrityScore) { this.integrityScore = integrityScore; }
        public String getIntegrityStatus() { return integrityStatus; }
        public void setIntegrityStatus(String integrityStatus) { this.integrityStatus = integrityStatus; }
        public Integer getVerifiedLogs() { return verifiedLogs; }
        public void setVerifiedLogs(Integer verifiedLogs) { this.verifiedLogs = verifiedLogs; }
        public Integer getTotalLogs() { return totalLogs; }
        public void setTotalLogs(Integer totalLogs) { this.totalLogs = totalLogs; }
        public java.sql.Timestamp getExportDate() { return exportDate; }
        public void setExportDate(java.sql.Timestamp exportDate) { this.exportDate = exportDate; }

        // Helper para obtener logs
        public List<ImmutableLog> getLogs() {
            if (data instanceof ModelTraceability) {
                return ((ModelTraceability) data).getLogs();
            } else if (data instanceof ProjectTraceability) {
                return ((ProjectTraceability) data).getLogs();
            } else if (data instanceof AgentTraceability) {
                return ((AgentTraceability) data).getLogs();
            }
            return new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
            evidence.setVerifiedLogs(integrityReport.getTotalLogsChecked());
```
